mainEntity.name: What's the difference between a minor update and a full bathroom renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: A minor update typically involves cosmetic changes such as painting, replacing fixtures (faucet, light), and possibly installing a new vanity or toilet without altering the layout. It's a cost-effective way to refresh the look. A full bathroom renovation, conversely, often includes changing the layout, moving plumbing or electrical lines, replacing bathtubs/showers, and installing new flooring. This approach offers a complete transformation but requires more time, planning, and investment. Your choice depends on your desired outcome and budget.
acceptedAnswer.description: Minor updates are cosmetic changes like painting and fixture replacement, while full renovations involve layout changes, moving utilities, and replacing major elements for a complete transformation.
